contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy. Coin. Nummus of House of Constantine (306-361), issue of 330-335, Reece period 17. Obverse description: Bust right. Obverse inscription: [--]ONST[--]. Reverse description: Two soldiers with [probably] two standards between them. Reverse inscription: [GLORIA EXERCITVS]. Diameter: 16mm, Weight: 1.77gms, die axis: 12
